method_name: TVB Epileptor network baseline (The Virtual Brain, tvb-library)

software_paper.authors: Sanz Leon P, Knock SA, Woodman MM, Domide L, Mersmann J, McIntosh AR, Jirsa V
software_paper.title: The Virtual Brain: a simulator of primate brain network dynamics

model_paper.authors: Jirsa VK, Stacey WC, Quilichini PP, Ivanov AI, Bernard C
model_paper.title: On the nature of seizure dynamics

network_application.authors: Jirsa VK, Proix T, Perdikis D, Woodman MM, et al.
network_application.title: The Virtual Epileptic Patient: Individualized whole-brain models of epilepsy spread
network_application.verified_via: Crossref API (metadata only; full text not read)

method_summary: Forward simulation of a connectome-coupled network of Epileptor neural masses (6D Epileptor, or the reduced Epileptor2D) with region-specific excitability x0. Seizure onset/propagation is read from simulated node activity (recruitment, onset times, duration). Virtual resection = removing nodes/edges; stimulation = external stimulus pattern applied to nodes. No inference by itself: x0 must be set by hypothesis (clinical EZ/PZ) or estimated (see BVEP/VBT).
required_inputs: structural connectome (weights + tract lengths) in a parcellation matching the SEEG gain model; tvb-data 3.0.0 provides default connectivity for testing (~52 MB wheel)
region excitability hypothesis x0 (from clinical EZ/PZ labels, or from inference)
SEEG contact positions + gain matrix to project to sensors (optional, for comparison with recordings)
intervention description (resected/ablated regions, or stimulated contacts mapped to regions)

implementation_versions.pypi: tvb-library 2.10.0, requires-python >=3.8, deps: autopep8, deprecated, docutils, ipywidgets, mako>=1.1.4, matplotlib, networkx, numba, numexpr, numpy, scipy, six
implementation_versions.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (PyPI licence text; GitHub API reports NOASSERTION)

supported_outputs: derived: recruited-node count, onset delays, seizure duration. These match the protocol's virtual_patient endpoint when paired with a no-intervention baseline.
validation_setting: Epileptor model introduced and compared with seizure recordings across species in Jirsa et al. 2014 (not re-read here). Network VEP models were evaluated retrospectively by the INS group (see Wang 2023 Sci Transl Med EvidenceClaim). The TVB baseline itself has no outcome validation for this study.
limitations: Forward model only; needs an x0 hypothesis or a separate inference step
Results sensitive to coupling K, x0 thresholds and noise; choices must be prespecified
Requires a patient connectome (DWI) for patient-specific use; a template connectome makes the model generic rather than personalised
GPL-3.0: redistributed derivative code must be GPL-compatible

local_run_requirements.python: 3.10 or 3.11 (pip install tvb-library==2.10.0; optional tvb-data==3.0.0 ~52 MB)
local_run_requirements.os: pure Python + numba; expected to run natively on Windows (not tested)
